_note: Error signatures seen when coding agents run in customer environments. Each maps a log pattern to the layer that owns it, the first things to check, and what an escalation must include. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.

signatures.title: Model API rate limit (429)
steps: Check whether it is per-minute or a usage-tier / quota limit (the response body says which).
Confirm the client retries with backoff and honours retry-after.
Lower agent concurrency or move to a higher tier.
escalate_with: request id from the response headers
requests per minute at the time

signatures.title: Not signed in or invalid credentials
signatures.pattern: 401 Unauthorized|invalid[_ ]api[_ ]key|authentication_error|not logged in|please (log|sign) in|Invalid bearer token
steps: Check which credential source the CLI resolved (env var vs saved login).
An env var with an old key shadows a newer login.
Regenerate the key if it was rotated.
escalate_with: which credential source is active (never the key itself)

signatures.title: Corporate proxy or TLS interception
signatures.pattern: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED|self[- ]signed certificate|unable to get local issuer certificate|ECONNRESET|tunneling socket could not be established|407 Proxy Authentication
steps: Check HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY.
Point the runtime at the corporate CA bundle (SSL_CERT_FILE / NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE).
Test the endpoint with curl -v from the same shell.

signatures.title: Missing dependency in the workspace
signatures.pattern: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named|Cannot find module|command not found: (python|node|npm|pytest)
steps: Install the project's dependencies in the environment the agent runs in (not only your shell).
Check the agent uses the same interpreter / virtualenv.
Add the setup step to the environment blueprint so it persists.

signatures.title: Git push or clone refused
signatures.pattern: Permission denied \(publickey\)|Authentication failed for 'https://|remote: Repository not found|could not read Username
steps: Check the integration has access to this repository.
SSH key or token missing in the agent's environment.
Branch protection can also refuse a push.

signatures.title: Container runtime unavailable
signatures.pattern: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon|docker: command not found|permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon
steps: Start the Docker daemon or add the user to the docker group.
In CI, use a runner with Docker available.

signatures.title: MCP server failed to start or connect
signatures.pattern: MCP server .* (failed|exited)|Failed to connect to MCP|mcp.*ENOENT|Connection closed.*mcp
steps: Run the server command by hand in the same directory.
Check the command path and env vars in the MCP config.
For remote servers, check the URL and the bearer token.

signatures.title: Context window exceeded
signatures.pattern: context[_ ]length[_ ]exceeded|prompt is too long|maximum context length|input length .* exceeds
steps: Large files or logs were read whole; narrow the reads.
Enable compaction or start a fresh session with a summary.
Exclude build output and vendored code from the workspace.

signatures.title: Agent ran past its time budget
steps: Check whether it was stuck in a loop (same command repeated) or slow tests.
Raise the budget only after the loop cause is ruled out.

signatures.title: Agent process crashed
signatures.pattern: Traceback \(most recent call last\)[\s\S]*agent/|Segmentation fault|panicked at|exit code 134|FATAL ERROR
steps: Collect the full stack trace and CLI version.
Retry once to see whether it reproduces.
This is a product bug: escalate, don't work around.
